text:
Alisha (AE): FYI — Contour Health wants a short POC. They want to bring a finetuned model (artifact name: contour-med-v1.tar.gz) and ask if we can run int4 variants on Dedicated/Private. Also need rough pricing delta (reserved vs PAYG) and any security blockers (PHI).

Marco (SalesEng): Do we know format? HF? Any custom ops?

Priya (SolutionsEng): They uploaded a tarball to the deal S3 earlier. Quick inspect: looks HF-style (config.json + tokenizer + pytorch weights). No custom CUDA ops at first glance. Planning a model-compat-scan now.

deploy-bot: model-compat-scan started for contour-med-v1 (scan id: scan-2026-03-21-001)

Priya (SolutionsEng): scan results:
- format: huggingface/transformers
- custom ops: none detected
- recommended quant: int8 ok, int4 possible with accuracy check
- attention path: fallback to tiled-attn for seq_len > 4096 (requires enabling tiled kernels)
- KV cache mem estimate @8k context: ~48GB RAM per model instance

Marco (SalesEng): KV cache ~48GB is big. For an 8k-context POC we'd need 2x A100-80GB or 2x H100-80GB in Dedicated to hit throughput targets. Any rough $ delta for reserved vs PAYG?

Priya (SolutionsEng): rough back-of-envelope for POC (3 months):
- Dedicated reserved (2x H100-80GB pool): ~$25,000/month (committed), includes 24/7 infra + SLAs
- PAYG hosted-style throughput equivalent (no reserved): ~ $0.35 per 1k tokens served (estimate) — depends heavily on batching and cache hit rate
- If we enable prefix/KV caching and batching we typically see ~25-35% token cost reduction in similar workloads

Alisha (AE): Customer also asked: if model contains PHI, do we need Private deployment or is Dedicated ok with BA?

Tom (Security): If PHI is present in inference or training data, we require either Private (customer-managed VPC/on-prem) or a Dedicated tenant with signed HIPAA BA and specific network/EKS constraints. Clarify whether training artifacts contain real PHI — that affects next steps.

Alisha (AE): They confirmed training data contained PHI in some clinical notes. They want the fastest path to POC while meeting compliance.

Priya (SolutionsEng): For PHI -> best options: Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) or Dedicated with a HIPAA BA. Lead times: Dedicated + BA ~2-3 weeks (procurement + legal). Private VPC deploy ~3-4 weeks (ops + infra). If they want immediate validation we can do an ephemeral Private deployment in their VPC for the POC (requires network access + infra creds).

Marco (SalesEng): Ok. Also need an ops checklist for the POC (model prep, endpoints, perf validation, rollback). Can you paste a quick example call for our API so they can validate integration?

Priya (SolutionsEng): Example curl to hit the model once deployed (replace MODEL_ID and API_KEY):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/MODEL_ID:predict" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"inputs":"Summarize patient note: ...","max_tokens":512,"temperature":0.0}'
```

Priya (SolutionsEng): Ops notes: enable tiled-attn flag in runtime to avoid attention CPU fallback for long contexts, set batcher window to 20ms for latency-sensitive inferencing, and enable prefix caching for repeated prefixes.

Marco (SalesEng): Can we hot-swap model variants during the POC so they can iterate on quantization levels (fp16 -> int8 -> int4) without downtime?

Priya (SolutionsEng): Yes — runtime supports model version pinning + canary rollout. Typical workflow: upload new variant, create "canary" route, route 5-10% traffic for validation, then promote. Example canary CLI snippet:

```
# create canary route
redwoodctl routes create --model MODEL_ID --variant canary-v1 --traffic 0.05
# promote
redwoodctl routes promote --route canary-v1 --to default
```

Tom (Security): Also need to note: KMS integration required for Private (customer-managed keys supported). Logging/audit retention policy must be set in contract (they asked for 7-year retention for audit logs).

Alisha (AE): Great. I'll send a summary email: cost options, lead times (Dedicated+BA 2-3w, Private 3-4w), compatibility caveats (attention tiled kernel, KV cache sizing), and next steps (confirm VPC creds or start BA). @Tom can you draft BA/contract addendum? @Pri please open internal runbook ticket "contour-poc-compat" and attach the scan output.

Tom (Security): Drafting BA addendum now, will share for review. :thumbsup:

Priya (SolutionsEng): Created ticket #OPS-1329 "contour-poc-compat" and uploaded scan artifact (scan-2026-03-21-001). I'll schedule a quick perf-run once infra is provisioned.

Alisha (AE): Thanks team — I'll follow up with Contour and loop in their infra lead to exchange VPC details.

Marco (SalesEng): thanks all. :rocket:
